notice: Fictional demonstration data. These prices and policies are illustrative and are not Pilon Digital commercial terms.
client_request: Example Client A needs a five-page English presentation website, a contact form and one CRM API integration. Target launch: six weeks. Budget and CRM provider have not been specified.
question: When can a demo deliverable be accepted, and when does support begin?

documents.title: Demonstration acceptance policy
documents.text: The customer has five business days to review a delivered demonstration milestone. Acceptance requires written confirmation after the agreed checks pass. Silence does not constitute acceptance.

documents.title: Demonstration support policy
documents.text: The demonstration support period starts on the date of written acceptance. It covers correction of reproducible defects within the agreed scope for thirty calendar days. New features require a separate agreement.

workflow_request: Prepare a small implementation plan for the website and CRM integration described in the client request. Include requirements, implementation, testing and delivery. Do not contact anyone or deploy software.
